'''Ghostly wraiths''' are [[undead]] summoned by [[Zemouregal]] in the battle against him during [[The World Wakes]]. They are extremely weak, and, much like the [[armoured zombies]] and [[skeleton bone thrower]]s that Zemouregal also summons, very easy to defeat.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=patch|update=Unwelcome Guests Slayer Content - This Week In RuneScape|date=11 April 2023}}
** Can be killed as part of the new undead slayer task.

* {{UL|type=update|update=The World Wakes|date=4 March 2013}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
*They are identical in appearance to the [[apparition]]s that a [[Shadowy Figure]] (who turns out to be Sliske) summons earlier on in the quest.
